verdict.rationale: Payment initiation is a fair axis for an open-finance provider, but the evidence shows no documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product and no stated live geographies. The 'pay' docs only cover payment-enablement data: ACH details, account owner verification, balances and payment-success prediction. 'Switch deposits and bill payments' is deposit/bill switching, an adjacent feature, not initiating a payment from a connected account.

support.subject: As a developer, I can initiate a bank payment from a connected account — a documented pay-by-bank or payment-initiation product with its live geographies stated honestly
